description: Presidential Secretariat - Extending the Term of the Commission on Simplification of existing laws any regulations in the Interest of the People
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and details the responsibilities assigned to a commission (simplification of laws and regulations, establishing quick service delivery mechanisms, creating a transparent and efficient system). It contains both the "who" (the President) and the "what" (detailed responsibilities and tasks), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
